```{r setup}
# Install required packages
required_packages <- c(
  "haven",
  "dplyr",
  "tidyr",
  "estimatr",
  "modelsummary",
  "knitr",
  "kableExtra"
)

missing_packages <- setdiff(
  required_packages,
  rownames(installed.packages())
)

if (length(missing_packages) > 0) {
  install.packages(
    missing_packages,
    repos = "https://cloud.r-project.org"
  )
}

library(haven)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(estimatr)
library(modelsummary)
library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)

data_path <- file.path("data", "oreopoulos-resume-study-replication-data-file.dta")
if (!file.exists(data_path)) {
  stop("Data file not found. Expected it at: ", normalizePath(data_path, mustWork = FALSE))
}
df <- read_dta(data_path)
```


```{r}
vars <- c("type", "female", "ba_quality", "extracurricular_skills", "language_skills",
          "ma", "same_exp", "exp_highquality", "reference", "accreditation", "legal")

df_int1 <- df %>%
  filter(
    type %in% c(0, 1),
    name_ethnicity %in% c("Canada", "Chinese", "Indian", "Pakistani")
  )
```


# Check for missing values across waves (fall_data)

```{r}
counts_all <- df_int1 %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(vars), as.character)) %>%
  pivot_longer(all_of(vars), names_to = "variable", values_to = "value") %>%
  mutate(variable = factor(variable, levels = vars)) %>%
  group_by(fall_data, variable) %>%
  summarise(
    with_value = sum(!is.na(value) & trimws(value) != ""),
    empty      = sum(is.na(value) | trimws(value) == ""),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  left_join(df_int1 %>% count(fall_data, name = "total_rows"), by = "fall_data") %>%
  relocate(total_rows, .after = fall_data) %>%
  arrange(fall_data, variable)

print(counts_all, n = Inf)

```

```{r}
df_int1 <- df_int1 %>%
  mutate(
    D = as.integer(type == 1),
    fall_data = factor(fall_data)
  ) %>%
  select(
    -reference,
    -accreditation,
    -legal
  )

# Create analysis dataset
df_analysis <- df_int1

# Verify sample
cat("Analysis sample size:", nrow(df_analysis), "\n")
cat("Treatment distribution:\n")
print(table(df_analysis$D))

cat("\nMissing same_exp values:\n")
print(sum(is.na(df_analysis$same_exp)))
```


# Section 1 — Covariate balance

The table presents observed counts and percentages by name type, differences in percentage points (foreign minus English), and signed standardised mean differences (SMD). 

## Balance calculations
```{r balance-calculations}
df_balance <- df_analysis %>%
  mutate(
    wave_0 = as.integer(fall_data == "0"),
    wave_1 = as.integer(fall_data == "1"),
    wave_2 = as.integer(fall_data == "2")
  )

balance_vars <- c(
  "language_skills", "extracurricular_skills", "same_exp",
  "female", "ba_quality", "ma", "exp_highquality",
  "wave_0", "wave_1", "wave_2"
)

stopifnot(all(vapply(df_balance[balance_vars],
                     function(x) all(is.na(x) | x %in% c(0, 1)), logical(1))))

balance_raw <- df_balance %>%
  select(D, all_of(balance_vars)) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = -D, names_to = "variable", values_to = "value") %>%
  group_by(variable, D) %>%
  summarise(
    valid_n = sum(!is.na(value)),
    count_one = sum(value == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
    missing_n = sum(is.na(value)),
    proportion = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = D,
              values_from = c(valid_n, count_one, missing_n, proportion),
              names_glue = "{.value}_{D}") %>%
  mutate(
    difference_pp = 100 * (proportion_1 - proportion_0),
    pooled_sd = sqrt((proportion_0 * (1 - proportion_0) +
                      proportion_1 * (1 - proportion_1)) / 2),
    smd = if_else(pooled_sd > 0,
                  (proportion_1 - proportion_0) / pooled_sd, NA_real_),
    English = sprintf("%d (%.2f%%)", count_one_0, 100 * proportion_0),
    Foreign = sprintf("%d (%.2f%%)", count_one_1, 100 * proportion_1)
  )
```

## Final balance table


```{r balance-table, echo=TRUE}
labels <- c(
  language_skills = "Language skills",
  extracurricular_skills = "Extracurricular activities",
  same_exp = "Multinational firm experience (same_exp)*",
  female = "Female",
  ba_quality = "Top 200 university (ba_quality)",
  ma = "Canadian master's degree (ma)",
  exp_highquality = "High-quality experience (exp_highquality)",
  wave_0 = "Wave 0 (fall_data = 0)",
  wave_1 = "Wave 1 (fall_data = 1)",
  wave_2 = "Wave 2 (fall_data = 2)"
)

balance_formatted <- balance_raw %>%
  mutate(
    Covariate = unname(labels[variable]),
    `Diff (pp)` = sprintf("%+.2f", difference_pp),
    SMD = sprintf("%+.3f", smd)
  ) %>%
  transmute(Covariate, English, Foreign, `Diff (pp)`, SMD,
            `Valid N (0)` = as.character(valid_n_0),
            `Valid N (1)` = as.character(valid_n_1),
            `Missing (0)` = as.character(missing_n_0),
            `Missing (1)` = as.character(missing_n_1))

blank_row <- function(label) {
  out <- as.list(rep("", ncol(balance_formatted)))
  names(out) <- names(balance_formatted)
  out$Covariate <- label
  as_tibble(out)
}
get_rows <- function(vars) {
  balance_formatted[match(unname(labels[vars]), balance_formatted$Covariate), ]
}

balance_display <- bind_rows(
  blank_row("Ex-ante moderators"),
  get_rows(c("language_skills", "extracurricular_skills", "same_exp")),
  blank_row("Other résumé characteristics"),
  get_rows(c("female", "ba_quality", "ma", "exp_highquality")),
  blank_row("Experimental / job characteristics"),
  get_rows(c("wave_0", "wave_1", "wave_2")),
  blank_row("Number of résumés")
)
balance_display$English[nrow(balance_display)] <- "3,026"
balance_display$Foreign[nrow(balance_display)] <- "2,631"

section_rows <- which(balance_display$Covariate %in%
  c("Ex-ante moderators", "Other résumé characteristics",
    "Experimental / job characteristics"))
total_row <- which(balance_display$Covariate == "Number of résumés")

balance_display %>%
  kableExtra::kbl(
    format = "html", escape = TRUE,
    col.names = c("Covariate","n (%)","n (%)","Diff (pp)","SMD","English","Foreign","English","Foreign"),
    caption = "Covariate Balance by Name Type"
  ) %>%
  kableExtra::add_header_above(c(
    " " = 1,
    "English-sounding names (D=0)" = 1,
    "Foreign-sounding names (D=1)" = 1,
    "Balance" = 2,
    "Valid observations" = 2,
    "Missing observations" = 2
  )) %>%
  kableExtra::kable_styling(
    bootstrap_options = c("striped", "condensed"),
    full_width = FALSE, font_size = 12
  ) %>%
  kableExtra::row_spec(section_rows, bold = TRUE, background = "#F2F4F7") %>%
  kableExtra::row_spec(total_row, bold = TRUE) %>%
  kableExtra::footnote(
    general = c(
      "* The same_exp variable is observed only in Waves 0–1. its balance statistics are therefore calculated using only Waves 0-1 observations rather than the full sample."
    ),
    general_title = "Notes: ", footnote_as_chunk = TRUE
  )
```
